# Crumb & Cardamom website rules

1. The brand name is "Crumb & Cardamom". It appears in the header and footer of every page.
2. The tagline is "Small-batch baking, big-hearted flavour." It appears in the hero section of the home page.
3. The tone is warm, friendly and simple: short sentences, plain English, and an occasional "shukriya" or "mazedaar".
4. Use only these colours: cream background #FFF8EC, cardamom green #3E6B4F for headings and buttons, saffron #E8A33D for accents, dark brown text #2B2118.
5. Use Google Fonts: "Playfair Display" for headings and "Poppins" for body text.
6. Every page has a header with navigation links to all pages, a clear page title or hero, and a footer with the brand name, hello@crumbandcardamom.com and "© 2026 Crumb & Cardamom".
7. Write prices as "Rs. 1,200": capital R, full stop, a space, and commas for thousands.
8. The order form asks for name, an 11-digit phone number, item, quantity and delivery date. It checks every field before submitting and shows a friendly thank-you message.
9. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, with no frameworks. The home page must be index.html in the root folder, and every page must work on phones.
10. Never use lorem ipsum, placeholder text, stock-photo links or colours outside the palette. Use emojis instead of images.
